description: Resource Type definition for AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration. Configures static 1:1 NAT on a transit gateway attachment. Each rule translates a source CIDR to a NAT CIDR. NatGatewaySupport controls whether creating this resource activates the rules or stages them; deleting this resource disables NAT gateway support and removes all NAT rules. This resource must be managed from the account that owns the transit gateway. NAT support depends on the attachment type, and the transit gateway rejects a request to configure NAT on an attachment type that does not support it.

NatSystemRouteSupport.description: Whether routes for the NAT CIDRs are installed into the transit gateway route tables associated with the attachment. Whether this is configurable depends on the attachment; where the value is forced, supplying the opposite value is rejected. Omitting this property leaves the setting to the service: on a new configuration the service applies the attachment's default, but on an attachment where the value is configurable it keeps the value already in effect rather than reverting to that default. Removing this property from a template, or deleting this resource, therefore leaves the setting at its last value rather than restoring the default, and a resource later created on the same attachment without this property inherits that value.
